name: GPU Fleet
author: j_kro
description: Fleet-wide GPU work management in the Omarchy bar: per-GPU utilization, VRAM, power, temperature, clocks and owning workload; miners with hashrate, power, pause/resume and estimated PRL/XMR earnings; LLM, image/audio and Jellyfin transcode workloads; k3s GPU pods; on-disk model inventory. Read-only by default — the only control (miner pause/resume) needs an explicit click plus confirmation.

barWidget.description: Fleet hashrate, loaded model count and GPU alerts; panel shows every GPU, workload, k3s GPU pod and on-disk model in the homelab.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often every miner's /summary endpoint is polled. The GPU view refreshes on its own ~20 s cache.

schema.label: What to show on the bar
Warn above (°C)
schema.description: Drives miner and GPU temperature warnings. GPUs with a flagged-unreliable temp sensor never alert.

schema.label: Earnings currency
schema.description: Fiat currency for the earnings estimate, converted from the pool's live rates feed.

schema.label: Earnings refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the PRL price and the pool's coins-per-day rate are re-fetched.
